title: Three and a Half Years
aka: time, times and half a time
lead: A span of three and a half years, or "a time, times and half a time," marks a limited time of trouble in Daniel (Daniel 7:25; Daniel 12:7; half of a "week" in Daniel 9:27) and in Revelation (Revelation 11:2–3; Revelation 12:6, 14; Revelation 13:5). Jesus and James remember Elijah's drought as lasting that long (Luke 4:25; James 5:17), and historicists counted the 1,260 days as years.
